name: Kaiser Manufacturing Co
old_description: Kaiser Manufacturing Inc. is a family owned and operated industrial textile manufacturer founded in 1960. We strive to serve our customers with quality, custom textile products. Our manufacturing product lines include specialty fabrics and services like industrial sewing, die cutting, programmable cutting, heat sealing through an ultrasound and hot air welder, and specialty packaging.
about:
Kaiser Manufacturing Inc. was founded in 1960 in West St. Paul, Minnesota, as a family-owned and operated industrial textile manufacturer. The company has remained under family ownership since its inception, focusing on custom textile products for industrial clients.

The company operates a facility equipped with more than 80 cutting and sewing machines and employs over 40 people. Its core services include industrial sewing, die cutting, programmable cutting, and heat sealing using both ultrasound and hot air welders. Kaiser Manufacturing produces a range of custom textile components such as straps, protective pads, bags, covers, filters, air diffusers, fabric ducting, and multi-material assemblies, along with specialty packaging.

Kaiser Manufacturing serves industrial customers requiring custom sewn, cut, and sealed textile products. Its product offerings address needs in applications such as protective padding, filtration, air handling, and multi-material assemblies, though specific industry sectors are not publicly detailed.

The company emphasizes its ISO 9001:2015 certification and a commitment to quality, collaboration, and customer service as the foundation of its six-decade track record.
